name: Combined Oxidative Phosphorylation Defect Type 30
aliases: Combined Mitochondrial Oxidative Phosphorylation Deficiency Type 30

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Combined Oxidative Phosphorylation Defect Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Early onset multisystemic clinical features including neurological and muscular symptoms
Deficient activities of multiple mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes in muscle or fibroblasts
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with oxidative phosphorylation defects
Brain MRI showing basal ganglia abnormalities or cerebral atrophy
Elevated lactate levels in blood or cerebrospinal fluid

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical presentation plus biochemical evidence of multiple respiratory chain complex deficiencies and genetic confirmation of pathogenic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, biochemical, and genetic data due to phenotypic heterogeneity.

searchTerms: developmental delay with loss of skills

laboratory: Elevated blood and CSF lactate and pyruvate levels
Multiple respiratory chain complex deficiencies on muscle biopsy
Elevated serum creatine kinase in some cases
imaging: Brain MRI showing basal ganglia lesions, cerebral atrophy, or leukoencephalopathy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in nuclear genes encoding mitochondrial proteins involved in oxidative phosphorylation
Mitochondrial DNA depletion or multiple deletions may be present
other: Muscle biopsy showing ragged-red fibers and abnormal mitochondrial morphology

distinguishingFeatures: Stroke-like episodes with focal neurological deficits
Onset typically in childhood or adolescence
Subacute necrotizing encephalopathy with characteristic MRI findings
Rapid neurodegeneration in infancy or early childhood
Specific mutations in mitochondrial or nuclear genes

redFlags: Severe lactic acidosis refractory to treatment
Multisystem involvement including cardiomyopathy and respiratory failure
references: Rahman S, et al. Mitochondrial disease: clinical features and diagnosis. J Inherit Metab Dis. 2020.
Parikh S, et al. Diagnosis and management of mitochondrial disease: a consensus statement from the Mitochondrial Medicine Society. Genet Med. 2015.
